notes.title: Thank you for 26000 downloads! Added Chinese screenshots!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/7055e56c24602c01df29a7035b722e2450545a6d.png[/img]
[h3]I was able to surpass 26,000 downloads last month on 2025/2/18![/h3]
I have been very busy since February, and it has been more than a month since my last report, but I would like to express my thanks to all the observers!

And it looks like we'll soon be able to announce the next happy news, such as 27,000 downloads...
(And if you look closely, the number of reviews on Steam...!)

[h1]【Chinese was added to the screenshots and renewed!】[/h1]
The process of incorporating the simplified and traditional Chinese translations into the Early Access version of the game finally came to an end today.

The integration into the game was almost finished in January, but it was also very difficult to reflect the translations on the Steam store page, so much so that we had to stay up all night for three days to finish...

Simplified and traditional Chinese versions of the following media have been added!
[list]
[*] Early Access Promotional Video
[*] Screenshots
[*] Novel Part Play Video
[*] Mini-game flow play video
[*] Gif animation
[/list]The old promotional vdeo in Japanese and English are no longer available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/17aefd8215d7be0deb8cc57625d0275b59293866.png[/img]
Not only the Chinese translation, but all the screenshots and videos of the Japanese & English versions have been updated to the latest version with visual effects!

In the Early Access PV, which is all about tempo, it looks the same except for the visual effects due to the fact that they were particular about not shifting a single frame, but there are some small changes in the mini-game scenes...
Other than that, the characters in the video seem to be different for each language!


[h1]【Notice Regarding Translation of Character Names】[/h1]
As a result of the completion of the translation of the Early Access version, we have decided to [b]change the translation of character names, except for As, in simplified and traditional Chinese characters only.[/b]
I apologize to any inspectors who have been calling the characters by their original names, and I would appreciate your understanding.


Simplified & Traditional Chinese versions are being prepared for release with the cooperation of the publisher Pujia8 Studio.
I will inform you of the release date as soon as it is decided!

■Pujia8 Studio Official Site
https://m.pujia8.com/

■Pujia8 Studio Official X
https://twitter.com/Pujia8Studio



[h1]【Translations of new games are also updated on the same day!】[/h1]
The new spin-off “Severed Love” also added screenshots and PV video in Simplified and Traditional Chinese today!
Please check out the new game together and add it to your wish list!
[b](The number of wishlist registrations for new game is also on the verge of 2,000!)[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412110/_/

notes.title: One week to go until the Early Access release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/5aa9484b438809e155a819de93ac80792867a060.png[/img]
[h3]I am now only "1 week" away from the release of the Early Access version of "Romp of Dump"!
The game will be released free of charge at around midnight Japan time on Saturday, 2024/1/20![/h3]


[h1]【Wishlist registrations have surpassed 2121!】[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/624db33b0738946af94499b1c675b39739e29f38.jpg[/img]
Thanks to the support of our observers, the number of Steam Wish List registrations has exceeded 【2121】!
For an unknown indie game, this is a truly honorable number.
I will do our best to release the game safely, so we hope you will watch over us.



[h1]【New contents of the Early Access version of the game!】[/h1]
(The screenshots are for the Japanese version, but the English version will be implemented at the same time.)

[h2]1. Main Scenario[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/a040cc80f36b16db3b717e2c07b30f5a0cf26533.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/94829f5b73c6ac1897225911dbb127527a73bd18.jpg[/img]
The main scenario exposes the bizarre crimes committed by the scum prisoners.
Of the three episodes, the core "Episode 2" can be played to the end for all characters!

[h2]2. Event illustrations animated in Live2D[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/be19f89acbc9300c403400bd41dcecfc6aac8883.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/ef29c43ea6318b3334094c85ac0fa1d7cdd5989a.jpg[/img]
When you play the main scenario, you can see event illustrations animated in Live2D.
Depending on the stills, there are gimmicks for facial expression/motion differences and animations unique to Live2D!
*Some of the text is withheld because it is a spoiler, but the text will be disclosed in the main game!

[h2]3. Hidden Characters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/04d45a72110d96db5d8ef0cf66564ba6bfcd3f54.jpg[/img]
You can release all of the prisoners, Durum, Franbel, and Drake, whom you could only meet once in the demo version.
Hidden characters can be released in exchange for chips at the in-game "SHOP".

[h2]4. New mini-game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/5647e37536ccadeb850e449586c0b7243c795666.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/4486660a0c199f21bf907f00d7dbcd50e08ac053.jpg[/img]
Prisoner scum kick each other down without honor!
You can play a new mini-game "Poker"!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/c59348b075919187d2b3349697364faebe413b08.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/00a8a6819f4da63860c6478ebaba281772fc1746.jpg[/img]
Another final mini-game is "Ask for Baccarat".
Based on Baccarat, the game asks the prisoner who plays the dealer "three questions" and guesses the correct answer.
Sometimes the dealer lies, and sometimes the questions are unimportant.

Both mini-games can be released in exchange for chips at the "SHOP".

[h2]5. Login Bonus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/899f748aeff39e9261e84b5b514287696b2ede8d.jpg[/img]
I will officially implement a login bonus where you can receive a chip or other rewards once a day.
Rewards will increase with cumulative and consecutive logins, so the more you log in, the more you can enjoy additional content.
The prisoner who welcomes you can also be freely changed from "CONFIG"!

[h2]6.図書館イベント[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/2a8989326ea453d462d46dca2c822b0544dda7cb.jpg[/img]
A new "Prison Library" has been added, where you can collect "case files" that will serve as hints for the mystery-solving part of the main scenario.
You can visit the library by winning the mini-game or playing the mini-game as many times as you like.

Durum, a model prisoner in charge of the library, and Franbel, a prisoner who somehow holds information related to the police.
Some of you may meet these two for the first time in the library.

[h2]7. New Penalty Game[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/26de1852f6bdd8caf9d437b21743702e8aa6cc66.jpg[/img]
I have also created a new episode of the penalty game, a fun game for the losers of the mini-game!
I are adding 10 (11 for Louq only) punishments per character.

After the release, I will add more in the form of a series of episodes!

[h2]8. New Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/28e64a39badc13f384411f57f91661758e70b982.jpg[/img]
The number of gift items ejected from the "Item Lottery" that can be exchanged in the "SHOP" has been doubled from 8 to 18 types!
The item raffle will also have 10 raffle items in a row without any cover, so please try to collect them!

[h2]9.Photo Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/128a8f2d29035b1ecd14350cd65bc82cc6ebddf5.jpg[/img]
Live2D "Photo Mode" has been officially implemented! You can take two shots with all the scum prisoners.
You can play it as a kind of punishment game by releasing it in exchange for a chip at the "SHOP".

Snapshots taken in Photo Mode are welcome to be posted on SNS!
Please read the guidelines on the official website, and by all means, please share them to make the game more exciting!
Guidelines: http://zakurobento.starfree.jp/RompOfDump/#Guideline


[h2]9. Steam Achievements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281147/ff5ee3224785e18cc1e60aa92c1099c96b757dc6.png[/img]
As of Early Access, 97 Steam Achievements have been implemented!
The number of mini-games played, wins and losses, and some of them can be unlocked by slightly surprising conditions.



All of these contents can be played entirely [b]for free[/b].
I am in the last spurt of development so that all observers can enjoy the game.
Please download and review when I release it!
